## Summary

Explain the behavior change, supported scope and related issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes without credentials.
- [ ] Relevant tests, documentation, native help and changelog are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private exports, receipts, customer data or generated outputs are committed.
- [ ] Backend, schema, storefront and installer migration/rollback implications are covered.
- [ ] Live UAT evidence is identified separately from mocked tests, where applicable.
- [ ] Payment verification, other payment methods and outstanding sessions remain protected.

## Release and risk

Describe compatibility, operational risk, known gaps and rollback. Do not attach
private logs or raw HAR files. Licence/publication approval is not implied by CI.
